build_detection_train_loader: build a dataloader for object detection training with configurable sampler, mapper, and aspect ratio grouping
build_detection_test_loader: build a dataloader for object detection inference with configurable batch size, sampler, and mapper
get_detection_dataset_dicts: load and prepare dataset dicts for instance detection or semantic segmentation from registered dataset names
build_batch_data_loader: build a batched dataloader with aspect ratio grouping, configurable batch size, and worker seed reset
load_proposals_into_dataset: load precomputed object proposals from a pickle file into dataset annotation records
